claim_scope: Label-exposed, held-out-by-computation FreeSolv reserve evaluation for two fixed Route 1 endpoints on one pinned GAFF MOL2 geometry per neutral closed-shell molecule in water. This is not an independent blind confirmation, a sampled finite-temperature free energy, a broad-solvent validation, or a force validation.

decision.failure_action: Do not tune on this reserve. Retain OBC-II/ACE as the product baseline and reject the CHA-GB/PBSA SP accuracy profile if any gate fails.
